lead.note: lead unwrought has only sub=Unwrought (no alloy series)

tin.note: verify tin metal has no alloy sub; builder excludes any *alloy* sub as a safety net

titanium.title: Titanium mineral (pigment feedstock)
titanium.note: ilmenite/rutile -> TiO2 pigment, NOT the aerospace sponge chain

prod: Platinum group metals (mine production, metal content)
trade: Platinum group metals (mine production, metal content)
platinum_group_metals.title: PGMs (metal content)
platinum_group_metals.note: metal-content both sides (kg); PGM content of trade — approximate

nickel.note: BGS combines smelter+refinery in production (NPI/ferronickel); cannot isolate class-I -> Indonesia exports invisible to the subtraction. Drop until a refinery-only series exists.

antimony.note: production is mine metal-content, trade is refined metal — stage mismatch (refiner illusion). No clean refined production series.

bismuth.note: mine metal-content vs refined metal trade — stage mismatch

arsenic.note: white arsenic (oxide) prod vs Arsenic trade — stage/form ambiguous

manganese.note: ore-only AC = a smelting-capacity map, not consumption (alloy is what moves and is dropped). Needs ore+alloy two-series.

chromium.note: same as manganese: ore-only measures smelting, not chromium consumption

rule: pair on FULL identity: erml_commodity AND erml_sub_commodity AND units AND stage. Assert units match; never convert; treat None(missing) as absent; exclude any *alloy* sub as a safety net.
